description: This file is a CodeMirror addon for XML folding, providing functions for folding, matching tags, and navigating XML tags within the CodeMirror editor.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Compares two positions based on line and character.

methods.name: tagAt
methods.description: Checks if the token at a given position is an XML tag.

methods.name: nextLine
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next line.

methods.name: prevLine
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous line.

methods.name: toTagEnd
methods.description: Finds the end of an XML tag, determining if it is self-closing or not.

methods.name: toTagStart
methods.description: Finds the start of the next XML tag.

methods.name: toNextTag
methods.description: Finds the next XML tag in the text.

methods.name: toPrevTag
methods.description: Finds the previous XML tag in the text.

methods.name: findMatchingClose
methods.description: Finds the matching closing tag for an opening tag.

methods.name: findMatchingOpen
methods.description: Finds the matching opening tag for a closing tag.
